content:
anya: noticed canary error spike right after rollout of prefix-cache v2 to canary pool at 00:11. 500s on /v1/generate for ~10% of requests. looking at traces now. :rotating_light:
anya: logs show `NullPointer` in cache index path, happens when key is empty string. repro locally with randomized inputs.
prod-alerts: metric alert: canary_high_5xx_rate > threshold (65m avg).
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident P12345 created and paged sam (primary oncall).
sam (oncall): on it — joining. can someone post the deploy SHA and flag name?
anya: deploy SHA `3a5b9f2` pushed by jordan at 00:09. feature flag is `feature/prefix_cache_v2` rolled to 10% canary via `flags-service`.
lee: confirmed stacktrace: `PrefixCache::get -> index.empty()` — looks like missing guard when `prefix` is `""` for short inputs. minimal fix is add `if (prefix.empty()) return miss;`.
jordan: ack. we can either hotfix the binary or kill the flag. killing flag is fastest.
sam (oncall): kill it first. please confirm command.
release-coordinator: use `POST /api/flags/kill` in console or `flagsctl set feature/prefix_cache_v2 off --scope=canary`. I'll run unless objections.
anya: please kill. we need immediate customer mitigation.
release-coordinator: running `flagsctl set feature/prefix_cache_v2 off --scope=canary` now...
release-coordinator: ✅ flag set to off for canary.
prod-alerts: canary_high_5xx_rate returning to baseline (trend).
sam (oncall): saw error rate drop within 30s of flip. good. rolling rollback for canary blockers?
jordan: I opened a revert PR `revert-3a5b9f2` to undo the single commit that enabled v2. `git revert --no-edit 3a5b9f2` and pushing to `canary-revert` branch. deploying now.
lee: while revert goes out, I'll draft a tiny patch to add the guard and a unit test for empty prefix. patch looks like:
```
- auto idx = build_index(prefix);
+ if (prefix.empty()) return Cache::miss();
+ auto idx = build_index(prefix);
```
I'll open a hotfix PR targeting `main` after revert if revert validated.
sam (oncall): deploy logs show `canary-revert` rollout started. watch for surge or latency regressions.
incident-bot: deploy `canary-revert` status: 40% -> 100% in 2m. success.
anya: monitoring traces — 5xx now back to normal. canary latency stable.
jordan: revert merged and released as `service-prefix-cache@v1.3.7` to canary and prod gradual.
sam (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. opening postmortem later. anyone with customer impact details?
anya: quick assessment: about 8% of canary traffic (10% of total) saw 5xx; roughly 0.8% of total requests. no high-value customers flagged yet; logs show a handful of API keys with 5xx — reaching out to success for proactive note just in case.
release-coordinator: action items: (1) follow-up hotfix PR with guard + unit test (lee), (2) add integration test for empty prefix inputs in QA (jordan), (3) improve canary monitoring to detect null/prefix anomalies earlier (devex).
lee: PR opened `hotfix/prefix-empty-guard` -> will target main. small change and unit test.
sam (oncall): handing back to oncall rotation at 01:00 UTC — I'll leave the incident open for postmortem notes and then close. good job on quick kill and revert. :thumbsup:
jordan: noted customer outreach task; handoff to success.
incident-bot: Incident P12345 status: mitigated -> follow-up required. scheduled postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
anya: closing notes: we chose killflag -> revert -> patch path to minimize risk. keep timeline and commands in postmortem.
sam (oncall): closing thread from paging perspective. will update PD incident and link postmortem when ready.
release-coordinator: final: tagging this as `root-cause: missing-guard-empty-prefix`, `mitigation: flag-kill + revert`, `impact: ~0.8% requests`, `sla_violations: none detected for enterprise customers`.
